mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we have fair conditions at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. If you look up at 5:43 PM tonight, you will see the International Space Station rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Madison area for a five minute show.

The city is preparing for upcoming elections with various public notices now available. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development site plans for the Liberty Business Park project.

We have a packed schedule starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow or catch the music of John Denver at the Verona Area High School Fine Arts Center on November 15.
Regarding recent activity, on October 25, officers arrested a man for his first O W I offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
